newsitem.title: JAPAN: US Treasury market in Tokyo closed for US holiday.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury market in Tokyo closed for US holiday.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury market in Tokyo is closed on Monday for the Martin Luther King Day holiday in the United States. Trading will resume on Tuesday.
Treasuries prices ended flat to slightly higher in a shortened session on Friday in New York, where the key 6-1/2 percent 30-year bond ended up 1/32 at 95-26/32 to yield 6.83 percent.
The market is looking towards Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's testimony before the Senate on Tuesday as the next market-moving event, Tokyo traders said.
